title: Director, Industrial Engineering
text:
**Job Title:**
Director, Industrial Engineering

**Job Location:**
Bellevue, WA

**Job Status:**
Exempt, Full Time

**About SHEIN**

SHEIN is a global fashion and lifestyle e-retailer committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all. We use on-demand manufacturing technology to connect suppliers to our agile supply chain, reducing inventory waste and enabling us to deliver a variety of affordable products to customers around the world. From our global offices, we reach customers in more than 160 countries. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has nearly 18,000 employees operating from offices around the world, with U.S. Headquarters located in Los Angeles.

In SHEIN, we work with outstanding, creative, and capable peers. We share an energetic and open culture for capable people to discern, work and ignite as a team.

At SHEIN, our culture is driven by our core values: Customer First, Take Ownership, Deliver Results, Make Change, and Celebrate Diversity. These are not just words, they are the principles that guide our work as we strive to meet the needs of our customers around the world.

**Position Summary**

As part of U.S. Fulfillment Operations, this director leads continuous improvement across SHEIN’s fulfillment center network. The role partners with site leaders and frontline teams to improve operating processes and management routines, owns the business intake and prioritization of warehouse system enhancements, and leads operational acceptance of system changes before deployment. The director works directly on priority initiatives and manages 1–2 direct reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Continuous Improvement and Standard Work***

* Own the network’s continuous improvement plan across receiving, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, shipping, and returns. Use site observations, performance data, and root cause analysis to identify bottlenecks, defects, and process variation.
* Lead Kaizen initiatives with site teams. Pilot changes, verify results, and scale effective practices through standard work, SOPs, training, and process audits. Improve management routines for shift handoffs, KPI reviews, issue escalation, and corrective action.
* Set baselines and track sustained improvements in safety, quality, throughput, labor productivity, cost per unit, and on-time fulfillment.

***Warehouse Systems Requirements Management***

* Own the Operations intake and backlog for warehouse management system (WMS) and related tool enhancements. Consolidate requests across sites and prioritize them with Operations leaders based on impact, urgency, risk, and effort.
* Translate operating gaps into business requirements, workflows, exception scenarios, acceptance criteria, and expected benefits. Partner with Product and Engineering, including China-based development teams, to clarify scope, assess trade-offs, and track requests through delivery.

***User Acceptance Testing and Deployment Readiness***

* Lead business UAT for new capabilities and system updates before production deployment. Define test scenarios, data, and pass criteria. Coordinate frontline users and site leads to validate end-to-end workflows, exceptions, and critical existing processes.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and QA to triage defects, retest fixes, and escalate release blockers. Document business sign-off and represent Operations in go/no-go reviews.
* Coordinate pilots, SOP and training updates, and site readiness checks. Monitor adoption, issues, and operational results after launch, and hand off stabilized changes to site leaders.

**For Pay Transparency**

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $180,000- $210,000 annually.

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role is eligible for additional discretionary bonuses and RSUs.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in fulfillment or warehouse operations, operational excellence, continuous improvement, or process engineering, with a record of measurable results across sites or operating functions.
* Hands-on experience applying Lean methods such as Kaizen, process mapping, root cause analysis, and standard work to improve warehouse performance.
* Working knowledge of WMS workflows and experience managing business requirements and leading business UAT or operational acceptance for warehouse system changes.
* Ability to influence site leaders, frontline teams, and technical partners across functions and geographies, while directly leading priority initiatives and managing a small team.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience scaling standard work or coordinating phased WMS deployments across multiple fulfillment centers.

**Benefits and Culture**

* Health Savings Account with Employer Funding
* Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare and Dependent care)
* Company-Paid Basic Life/AD&D insurance
* Company-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
* Voluntary Benefit Offerings (Voluntary Life/AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Accident)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Business Travel Accident Insurance
* 401(k) Savings Plan with discretionary company match and access to a financial advisor Vacation, paid holidays, floating holidays, and sick days
* Employee discounts
* Free swag giveaways
* Annual Holiday Party

**SHEIN**
is committed to an equitable and inclusive work environment for all candidates and provides equal opportunities in all employment practices without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or childbirth, age, disability, or veteran status.
